stories.title: U.S. Army says 101st Airborne demonstrates drone-delivered firepower with DARK and BLADE during live-fire
stories.summary: Soldiers from the U.S. Army’s 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault) used drones to deliver smoke and explosive munitions during live-fire training at Fort Campbell. The Nov. 2-8, 2026, exercise integrated the Drone Agnostic Release Kit (DARK) and Broad Lethality Air Deployed Effects (BLADE) to support simulated infantry operations.

stories.title: Robotics in 2027: The Winners Will Be Measured in Hours Without Human Help
stories.summary: The author predicts that in 2027, robotics suppliers and operators will make labor burdens visible by reporting interventions per task or operating hour. Commercial pilots will demonstrate bounded recovery using learned models on the robot itself, allowing machines to recognize failed attempts and choose allowed responses without network round trips.

stories.title: Vectigo launches road-embedded safety system for autonomous vehicles in Colorado
stories.summary: Vectigo, a Colorado-based company, launched a roadway-embedded safety platform using solar-powered sensor units to detect hazards like black ice and wrong-way drivers. The company aims to reach every state department of transportation within five years.

stories.title: Ukrainian troops joined the first Drone Crucible exercises with military personnel from the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany and Latvia
China Spots Unidentified Drone Resembling U.S. MQ-25 Stingray
stories.summary: Satellite imagery shows an unidentified jet-powered drone at Pucheng Airbase in Shaanxi Province, China, resembling the U.S. MQ-25 Stingray. The aircraft has a wingspan of approximately 20 meters and a length of around 15 meters, though its purpose remains unknown.

stories.title: Qatar begins phase two of electric Robotaxi test runs
stories.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Transport began phase two of electric robotaxi test runs in Doha, featuring two level-4 vehicles on specific routes for 12 months. This follows a first phase that covered nearly one million kilometers, exceeding the 500,000-kilometer goal.

stories.title: Mainline GWR rail passengers to get Wi-Fi created for F1 cars
stories.summary: Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander confirmed Treasury funding for satellite Wi-Fi on Great Western Railway trains, a hybrid system using low earth orbit satellites and mobile masts originally developed for Formula 1 cars. The rollout will serve passengers in the South West as GWR enters public ownership in December.

stories.title: NATO Reconnaissance Aircraft Monitors Kaliningrad Region During Drone Attack
stories.summary: A NATO Boeing E-3A Sentry surveillance aircraft monitored the drone attack on Russia’s Kaliningrad region on November 21. The aircraft, identified by callsign NATO01, took off from Geilenkirchen Air Base in Germany and patrolled Polish airspace near Kaliningrad, circling near Gdańsk from 7:30 p.m. to 8:20 p.m. local time before moving toward Ostrołęka and eventually heading to Talsi Airbase in Latvia.

stories.title: Gun-toting 'robot dogs' storm gang-controlled stadium where human skulls were found
stories.summary: El Salvador's military deployed armed robotic dogs to assist in clearing the Sylvio Cator Stadium in Haiti, where troops discovered human skulls. The joint task force, comprising Salvadoran Special Forces and Haitian security units, reclaimed control of the stadium, which will now be converted into an operational base.

stories.title: Darmstadt robotics startup Telekinesis wins Frankfurt’s 2026 Startup of the Year award
stories.summary: Telekinesis, a robotics company spun out of TU Darmstadt, was named Frankfurt Forward Startup of the Year 2026 during the EURO FINANCE Tech Day in Frankfurt. The company develops a cloud-based platform to simplify the programming and autonomous control of various robotic systems, including industrial robots, drones, and humanoid platforms.

stories.title: Renegade UxS Shows Nightmare Drone at Fort Bragg
stories.summary: Renegade UxS Inc. set up a booth at Modern Warfare Week, held November 16-19 at Fort Bragg and nearby sites in the Fayetteville, North Carolina, area. The company's Nightmare FPV drone joined the U.S. government's Blue UAS Cleared List in December 2025.

also.title: Maker of combat-proven Ukraine drone courts US special forces

stories.title: Morocco ranks second in Africa with 271 military drones, database shows
stories.summary: Morocco's military drone fleet expanded to 271 units last year, ranking second in Africa behind Egypt's 313, according to Unmanned Africa data. The Royal Armed Forces acquired 164 drones in 2020 alone, with Israeli-made aircraft comprising approximately 65% of the inventory.

stories.title: Ukrainian Mirage 2000 shoots down Russian jet drone with gun
stories.summary: A French-supplied Mirage 2000 fighter shot down a Russian jet-powered attack drone with its built-in DEFA 554 30mm cannon, according to footage released by Ukraine’s Air Force. The Air Force published the video with a caption thanking the pilot for the accuracy.

stories.title: Air Raid Alert Sounds in Russia's Kaliningrad as Finland Battles Fire on Drone-Hit Cargo Ship
stories.summary: A rare air raid alert sounded in Kaliningrad late Saturday after a suspicious object from Lithuania triggered sirens in the Nemansky district, the first such alert since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine began on Feb. 24, 2022. Hours earlier, a drone strike set fire to the Russian cargo ship Sparta II in the Gulf of Finland, where Finnish emergency services were still battling the blaze on Sunday.

also.title: Russian Military Cargo Ship Drifts Into NATO Waters After Drone Strike, Risks Sinking

stories.title: I saw Russian power from the inside. This is how Ukraine’s drones are really h
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries this year have produced spectacular images of raging fires – and some breathtaking estimates of the damage done. The Wall Street Journal recently put the affected capacity of Russia’s output at 59 per cent, while Bloomberg reported 40 per cent and Reuters roughly 30 per cent.

stories.title: EU Drone Projects: The Art of Doing a Lot, Yet Producing Nothing
stories.summary: Stakeholder feedback at the EU Drone Summit in November 2026 indicated that 59% saw no significant progress in U-space implementation, while 34% reported moderate progress and none reported good progress. The European Commission is still reviewing progress on the EU Drone Strategy 2.0, introduced in 2022, and is preparing another implementation roadmap expected in 2027.

stories.title: DropShip autonomous cargo aircraft heads for serial production
stories.summary: Pyka’s DropShip autonomous cargo aircraft is moving toward serial production after a second airframe completed ground testing. The company plans to conduct flight testing and real-world demonstrations next, following the first aircraft’s maiden flight in April.

stories.title: San Antonio council members push Austin rail as studies price two routes
stories.summary: San Antonio City Council members pushed for Austin-San Antonio passenger rail as two studies price the link at $810 million to $13.5 billion. District 7 Council Member Marina Alderete Gavito filed a Council Consideration Request on Nov. 16, 2026, asking for a hearing at the earliest available meeting of the council’s Governance Committee.

stories.title: U.S. naval supremacy threatened as underwater arms race gains steam: ‘Underwater drones will likely reshape the future of war fighting at sea,’ expert says
stories.summary: Morgan Bazilian, director of the Colorado School of Mines’ Payne Institute for Public Policy, stated that the United States lacks the industrial capacity to build underwater drones at scale. He warned that underwater drones “will likely reshape the future of war fighting at sea.”

stories.title: Ukrainian authorities warn people may be trapped under rubble after Russian drone attack
stories.summary: Search and rescue operations were ongoing with emergency crews removing the debris of the damaged structure and searching for those potentially trapped.

stories.title: California Bars Waymo Driverless Taxis From State Freeways
stories.summary: California's Department of Motor Vehicles barred Waymo's driverless taxis from state freeways on 11 November, citing safety concerns after incidents involving construction zones and traffic breaks. The restriction remains in place until Waymo addresses the safety lapses, with no fixed end date set.

also.title: Self-Driving Robotaxis Just Got A Big Banhammer In California

stories.title: MIT voxel blocks let imprecise robots build load-bearing demos
stories.summary: MIT visiting researcher Miana Smith developed voxel blocks that absorb 10 millimeters of placement error, allowing low-cost robots to assemble load-bearing structures. Her first field partner, Druk Holding and Investments, plans an outdoor test for housing at Gelephu Mindfulness City, while Smith targets concrete formwork next.

stories.title: Boom Supersonic Runs Prototype Core of In-House Engine for First Time
stories.summary: Boom Supersonic test engineers ran the prototype core of the company's in-house engine for the first time on Nov. 21 at the Colorado Air and Space Port in Watkins. The core reached 6,500 rpm with nearly 2,000 real-time sensors, and Boom expects to expand the test envelope over the next two months.

stories.title: This shape-shifting robot looks like real transformer; can bend, grab and combine for new role
stories.summary: Colorado State University’s Adaptive Robotics Lab researchers developed the TeCoBot, a 23-inch flexible robot that can bend, grab, and combine with others to form new machines. While the robots demonstrated autonomous docking, most movements and cooperative tasks still require human control.

stories.title: Six Chennai Metro stations may wait until mid-2027 for automated train trials
stories.summary: Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) may delay opening six Phase II stations on the Porur–Vadapalani section until mid-2027, as civil works finish by early 2027 but automated train trials remain incomplete. The stations can open only after trains run in Automatic Train Operation (ATO) mode and the Commissioner of Metro Railway Safety grants clearance, with one official stating that CMRS will not accept trains operated in manual mode.

stories.title: Riding Brightline From Miami to Orlando: 11 Things First-Timers Should Know
Akinci drone drops Türkiye's ORKA torpedo in first unmanned release
stories.summary: Baykar's Bayraktar Akinci drone dropped Roketsan's ORKA torpedo in the first unmanned release of the national weapon, a test conducted over the Gulf of Saros. The 220-kilogram torpedo, which has a 15-kilometer range, separated safely from the aircraft's wing and entered the water at the designated point.

stories.title: From Gaming Screens To The Battlefield: Malaysia's Search For A New Breed Of Drone Operators
stories.summary: Malaysia's Chief of Defence Force, General Tan Sri Malek Razak Sulaiman, said the Armed Forces are exploring video gaming experience to identify recruits for an expanding military drone programme. The initiative supports intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance missions in the South China Sea and waters off Sabah, following the induction of Turkish-made ANKA-S unmanned aerial systems into No. 11 Squadron at Labuan Air Base.

stories.title: Korea National Railway group wins Vietnam high-speed rail design retender
stories.summary: A consortium including Korea National Railway, Systra, and TEDI won the retendered Vietnam high-speed rail feasibility study and front-end engineering design package, valued at about VND 10.8 trillion. Korea’s Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced the award on November 21, with work scheduled from November 2026 to May 2029.

also.title: Korean consortium wins Vietnam high-speed rail design contract

stories.title: Russian ship burns off Finland after suspected drone attack: ‘War is spilling over’
stories.summary: Finnish authorities said the Sparta II, a Russian-flagged cargo ship with military connections, was likely attacked by Ukrainian drones in the Baltic Sea on Saturday. The 16-member crew abandoned the burning vessel, which drifted into Finnish waters, while Finland led the rescue operation and introduced temporary aviation and maritime restrictions in the eastern Gulf of Finland.

stories.title: Russia’s Baltic Fleet Base Comes Under First-Ever Suspected Drone Attack in Kaliningrad
stories.summary: Residents reported explosions and suspected drone activity near Russia’s Baltic Fleet naval base in Baltiysk, Kaliningrad region, on November 21. Russian air defense systems engaged aerial targets, though reports remain unverified and no confirmed damage to warships or infrastructure has emerged.

stories.title: How the Conflict in Ukraine is Driving Changes in US Drone Use, Base Security, and Military Organization
Humanity’s Supersonic Dream: How Concorde Conquered the Atlantic and Why It Disappeared from the Skies
stories.summary: British Airways and Air France inaugurated scheduled supersonic services to New York from London and Paris on 22 November 1977. Concorde covered the route in less than three and a half hours, allowing passengers to arrive in New York earlier than they departed London.

stories.title: Drones Strike Rosgvardiya Headquarters in Krasnodar
stories.summary: Long-range strike drones attacked Krasnodar overnight into Sunday, Nov. 22, likely hitting the Main Directorate of the Russian National Guard (Rosgvardiya) for Krasnodar Krai. Aviation authorities temporarily suspended arrivals and departures at Krasnodar International Airport, while Ukrainian open-source channels reported smoke near the Afipsky Oil Refinery.

also.title: Ukrainian Drones Reportedly Hit Russian National Guard Headquarters Deep Inside Russia

stories.title: Tesla Driverless Model Y Planned Without Steering Wheel
stories.summary: Elon Musk announced plans on November 18, 2026, for a Tesla driverless Model Y without a steering wheel or pedals to carry up to seven passengers. The vehicle is intended as a larger counterpart to the two-seat Cybercab, which entered service in Austin in September and expanded to Dallas on November 19. Tesla has not confirmed whether the control-free Model Y will be available for private purchase or remain fleet-only, and no release date has been given. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened an audit query on September 4, 2026, into Cybercab self-certification regarding compliance with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards.

stories.title: Neural Network With Sliding Data Window Enhances Autonomous Ship Path
stories.summary: Maritime researchers developed an adaptive predictive control framework that enhances autonomous ship path following by merging a feedforward neural network with a real-time sliding data window. Validated through numerical simulations of the commercial car carrier vessel Hual Trooper, the system stabilizes underactuated vessels along planned rhumb lines without relying on rigid physical mechanism equations.

stories.title: California man tests Mercedes' answer to Tesla’s Full Self-Driving and finds out something he didn't expect
stories.summary: YouTuber Everyday Chris tested Mercedes' MB Drive Assist Pro in San Francisco, noting the system uses 10 cameras, five radar sensors, and 12 ultrasonic sensors. The city-driving feature launches in California in December 2026, with a broader U.S. rollout starting in 2027.

stories.title: Kentucky County Drone Finds Escaped Man After 13-Hour Manhunt
stories.summary: Adair County Emergency Management used a drone to locate Deon Bostic, who escaped custody in Columbia, Kentucky, after 13 hours. Kentucky State Police arrested Bostic in a field near Breeding on Saturday, November 21, after he was spotted walking in a field.

stories.title: Ukraine, UK Agree to Jointly Produce Ukrainian Deep-Strike Drones in Britain
stories.summary: Ukraine and the UK signed project agreements on Saturday, Nov. 21, to jointly produce battlefield-proven Ukrainian middle-strike and deep-strike drones in Britain. Funded by London, the finished drones will be delivered directly to the Armed Forces of Ukraine, according to Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense.

stories.title: Uber and Momenta Launch Robotaxi Pilot in Munich
stories.summary: Uber and Momenta launched a supervised autonomous vehicle pilot in Munich, offering the first autonomous rides through the Uber app in Germany. The free, non-commercial service operates under special test permits from the Federal Motor Transport Authority (KBA) and covers a defined area in northern Munich, including neighborhoods surrounding the Olympic Park. A trained safety operator remains on board every vehicle, and selected pre-registered riders can access the service via the Uber app.

stories.title: Tesla launches Cybercab, fueling speculation of SpaceX merger
stories.summary: Tesla initiated sales of its new Cybercab, an autonomous electric vehicle available exclusively to select U.S. customers. The launch supports Tesla’s plan to enhance robotaxi services by 2027, fueling speculation about a possible merger with SpaceX, though no official announcements have been made.

stories.title: Turkish F-16s scrambled as drone-hit Russian ship Sparta II burns in Finnish waters
stories.summary: Turkish F-16s scrambled from Estonia's Amari air base after drones struck the Russian cargo ship Sparta II in the Gulf of Finland. The vessel, owned by Oboronlogistika, drifted into Finnish waters and anchored off Loviisa, where it continues to burn.

also.title: Drone-hit Russian cargo ship still on fire in Finnish waters, crew evacuated
Russian cargo ship still on fire off Finland after drone attack

stories.title: Bill Aims to Study How Self-Driving Vehicles Can Be Integrated Into Illinois Transit
Most Prime Air drone orders arrive in under 90 minutes, Amazon says
Air defenses down 161 of 186 Russian drones launched against Ukraine since evening
stories.summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 161 of 186 Russian drones launched against Ukraine since the evening of November 21. The attack involved Shahed, Gerbera, and Parodiya-type drones, with hits recorded at 18 locations and debris falling at six.

stories.title: China displays advanced AI, robotics, and manufacturing ahead of APEC conference
stories.summary: China is demonstrating its latest developments in artificial intelligence, robotics, and manufacturing in Shenzhen and Guangzhou ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation conference. Highlights include service robots for various tasks, a robotic arm capable of deep-sea diving, autonomous electric helicopters and air taxis, and a partially automated electric vehicle assembly line in Guangzhou.

stories.title: LAPD Chief Warns of Weaponized Spray Drones at the 2028 Olympics
stories.summary: Los Angeles Police Chief Jim McDonnell says agricultural spray drones from California’s Central Valley could be weaponized against the 2028 Olympics, and that getting technology, training and authorizations up to speed for drone threats is going to be a challenge. His comments were part of an ABC7 Los Angeles report on Olympic security planning published Saturday, with about 600 days left before the Games open.

stories.title: Record tram orders: how Stadler, Škoda, CAF and Alstom dominate Europe’s renewal wave
stories.summary: The London Court of International Arbitration ordered Ethiopian Railways Corp to pay Turkish contractor Yapı Merkezi US$307.6m, concluding a dispute over construction works for the Awash – Kombolcha – Hara Gebeya railway which were suspended because of the war in Tigray.

stories.title: Lithuanian-speaking robot joins library staff: âIt can read, tell stories'
stories.summary: Gargždai Public Library will add ALTAS, a Lithuanian-speaking humanoid robot, to its staff starting the New Year. The robot, the first in Lithuania designed specifically for library work, will answer visitor questions and recommend books by genre. Library director Aurelija Butkutė-Norkevičienė said the team is refining its pronunciation and plans to use ALTAS for children's events and to engage students with special educational needs.

stories.title: Waymo Recalls Robotaxis Over Closed Lanes and Police-Directed Traffic
stories.summary: Waymo issued a software recall for its robotaxis on Friday to fix problems navigating closed freeway lanes and manually directed intersections. The update follows California's ban on the company's driverless taxis from state highways and a nationwide pause on freeway rides.

stories.title: Amazon Drone Hit a Wire and Came Down on a Garage, Customer Says
stories.summary: An Amazon Prime Air drone landed on a resident’s shed in Huntington Woods, Michigan, on November 20 after dropping a package in a customer’s backyard. Amazon stated that nobody was injured and that the drone has been removed.

also.title: Another MK30 down: how many eggs does Amazon need to break before someone gets hurt?

stories.title: Caught on camera: Chinas driverless car makes 868 parking attempts at 3 am, leaves security guard baffled
stories.summary: A driverless electric car in Anhui province activated its automatic parking function 868 times at 3 am, baffling a security guard who found no one inside the vehicle. The car eventually stopped beside another parked car, though the exact cause of the repeated maneuvers remains unclear.

stories.title: Muncie Bill Would Put Every Police Drone Purchase to a Council Vote
stories.summary: Three members of the Muncie, Indiana, City Council filed an ordinance on November 17 that would bar every city agency from buying, leasing or accepting a drone without a council vote first. The bill follows months of local reporting on police license plate cameras from Flock Safety, and it orders any plate readers installed on city property without council approval to be switched off and removed.

stories.title: Lithuania denies involvement in drone attack near Kaliningrad
stories.summary: Lithuanian Foreign Minister Kęstutis Budrys denied involvement in a drone incident near Kaliningrad, stating Lithuania never authorized the use of its airspace for attacks on Russian territory. Governor Alexey Besprozvannykh reported air-raid sirens activated in the Neman district on 21 November after detecting a suspicious object, though no damage or casualties were confirmed.

also.title: Lithuania Denies Role in Kaliningrad Drone Strike
